adoption.rationale: The helper Base64-encodes SHA-256(code_verifier), removes padding, and maps the standard alphabet to the URL-safe alphabet before the challenge is sent in an OAuth authorization request. RFC 7636 requires the S256 code challenge to be BASE64URL(SHA256(ASCII(code_verifier))) and defines base64url without padding. The contract covers this output mapping only; it does not claim verifier entropy, state generation, server enforcement, or CSRF correctness.
